newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Premiere rises 4.76 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Premiere rises 4.76 pct in late trade.

text.p: Movie producer Premiere Entertainment Productions Inc climbed by six centavos, or 4.76 percent, to 1.32 pesos in late trade as it benefited from a general wave of buying, brokers said.

"It's also a small issue and it's easy to take advantage of the small size. At this level, it's fairly valued but over 1.36 pesos, it will be hard to believe," said Saturnino Mejia, research head at Guoco Securities Phils Inc.

Premiere made a successful listing of its 180 million initial public offering shares at the stock market on Monday and its share price has risen 32 percent. Premiere shares were offered at one peso apiece.
The issue was among the top 10 most heavily traded stocks in late session.
The rest of the market was also up with the Philippine Stock Exchange's main index rising over 48 points, or 1.78 percent, to 2,785.12 about 30 minutes before the close of trading.
